subject: BUG: placeholder text opacity:0.7 fails WCAG AA -- fix: remove opacity
body:
BUG: Placeholder text fails WCAG 1.4.3 in both light and arena modes

Filed by: GD WCAG input audit
Priority: Medium

FINDING
shared/styles.css line 378-381:
  input::placeholder, textarea::placeholder {
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    opacity: 0.7;
  }

The opacity: 0.7 blends --text-secondary with the input background, producing:
- Light mode: #5E6378 @ 0.7 on #F8F9FC -> blended #8c90a0 -> 3.02:1 FAIL (need 4.5:1)
- Arena mode: #8B92A8 @ 0.7 on #1A2240 -> blended #697089 -> 3.18:1 FAIL (need 4.5:1)

WCAG 1.4.3 requires 4.5:1 for normal-size text. Placeholder text is text. No exemption applies.

FIX
Remove opacity: 0.7 from the placeholder rule.
--text-secondary at full opacity on its respective bg:
- Light: #5E6378 on #F8F9FC = 5.65:1 PASS
- Arena: #8B92A8 on #1A2240 = 5.03:1 PASS

The opacity was probably added to visually differentiate placeholder from real input text,
but --text-secondary is already a subdued color -- the full value reads as placeholder-like.
If visual distinction is still desired, could lower line-height or use font-style:italic instead.

CHANGE
shared/styles.css line 380: remove 'opacity: 0.7;'

Result:
  input::placeholder, textarea::placeholder {
    color: var(--text-secondary);
  }

ACCEPT CRITERIA
- Placeholder text visible in exam answer inputs
- No opacity property on placeholder rule
- Both light and arena mode pass WCAG 1.4.3 (4.5:1)
